[img]https://i.imgur.com/Z4GOv8H.png[/img] This mod adds several fish-related resources, buildings and activities. See the forum thread for content/changelog. https://ludeon.com/forums/index.php?topic=13172.msg133445#msg133445
[h1]FishIndustry[/h1]
There is so much water in this world and you always dreamt to eat a fresh grilled fish! Here it comes, the Fish Industry debarks in Rimworld!
[h1]Features[/h1]
- Fishing zone: designate a zone where your fishers can fish. Waters can be dangerous if tailteeths live in this biome. - Fishing pier: simple building built on water. Allow your hunters to catch safely some fishes. Use corn or rice to fasten fish catch! - Aquaculture basin: advanced building used to breed some aquatic species. Expensive renewable source of meat. Is unlocked by "Aquaculture" research after "Hydroponics". - New recipes at the campfire (to cook a grilled fish simple meal). - Oyster as joy food. - New meditative joy activity on fishing pier (watching shiny water).
[h1]Important notes[/h1]
- Fishing is a hunting job. The jobs' priorities are defined as follow: hunting operating aquaculture basin fishing at fishing pier. - You can stop fishing activities by forbidding the pier or aquaculture basin.
